statement: Stable Genius gives +1 total wisdom per level; stronger than Roid Raging and Swift Steppin.
Stable Genius is the strongest of all the total-stat bubbles; not even a question.
This bubble gives a percent higher bonus to offline gains and costs viney logs from the giant tree.
Viney logs are only ever printed for this bubble; it helps AFK gains a decent amount.
Because it costs viney logs and you hit kill cap anyway it is not a huge priority; scales terribly.
Placed high C tier; okay early to mid game but falls off hard later.
Gives total percent damage; don't let the description fool you.
Some would put it with Britney Spears or Bojack but he disagrees and drops it to B tier.
Costs red salts; you are waiting on No Bubble Left Behind to upgrade it so B tier.
Call Me Pope gives times worship charge rate per hour and max worship charge but causes crabbos; non-linear bubble.
Auto-equip bubble; strong early mid and late game; you trade trapping gains for worship gains; top tier.
Gospel Leader gives percent max charge per 10 worship levels.
Starts weak but becomes disgustingly strong late game; not linear until later so not prioritized; costs mesquite's nose?.
Gospel Leader is placed below Matty Stat.
Smart boy talent bubble gives talent points specifically for the Mage and costs sippy straws.
You 100% need it if pushing with ES and Bubo; mages are incredibly talent hungry; only affects one character.
Purple Bargain reduces purple bubble material costs by a percentage; same as every other bargain bubble.
Bad cost; scales down quickly; not good early since few green souls; C2 not a priority.
Nickel of Wisdom gives money from monsters for every 250 wisdom; costs alien logs.
Best of the wisdom bubbles because Bubo is your money farmer and it scales money percent very hard.
Not S tier because you get it late and alien logs are expensive; placed top of the A tier.
Severe purple multiplies bonuses of bubbles 1st third fifth 13th and 15th: stable genius and hocus chopsus and nude bubble and gospel leader and purple bargain.
Only two important multiplied bubbles are Hocus Chopsus and Stable Genius.
His level 271 Severe Purple gives 2.26 times; causes voidor?; somewhat expensive but not terrible; easily A tier.
Tree sleeper gives chopping AFK gains and costs purple souls.
This is how he got a 1.2 billion oak log print; really strong; top of B tier.
Hyperswift gives percent basic attack speed; not that good; not hard prioritized; manta rays not easy to get.
Mage is Best multiplies every small passive bubble except big bubbles and the first bubble.
Easy S tier; multiplies everything.
Evolved Matrix is a big bubble giving percent lab XP; costs cube logs; additive bonus.
Never equipped it; first said low C2 but takes it back and calls it F tier dog bubble.
Wand Power gives 27 more weapon power but only for wands or fisticuffs; costs bits.
Best of the power bubbles since V-man has low power and trouble building high damage; placed bottom of A tier.
Gives chopping and worship power per 100 items found in the slab; requires scarabs from World 5 catching.
Priority later game since most haven't done slab farm; scarabs hard to catch; placed right above Gospel Leader at B2.
Pius at Heart costs late-game sailing materials; bubble 23; good if pushing divinity to about 120.
Not linear and not obtained during Divinity farm; placed top of C tier.
Gives base wisdom per 100 items found shown in the slab; costs crawler materials; insane bubble.
Bubble 24 is one of the last you get; given cost and when unlocked placed bottom of its tier.
Gives total damage percent per 250 wisdom; beginners get luck; costs musical notes.
One of the biggest damage spikes; Mages get much wisdom; placed at top.
Hocus Chopsus gives chopping efficiency per power 10 of max MP; costs nails.
Literally mandatory for prints; people hard focus it; would be higher tier if it didn't cost nails.
Multilago increases multi-log chop chance and raises the cap to 300 instead of 100 percent; costs iron bars.
Iron bars are hard to get and not everybody has brimstone slots; but still top of A tier.
Nude bubble gives choppin? and alchemy XP; costs chains.
Negligible because you get lots of XP from Shaman; additive; skilling easy to level; placed middle C2.
Best base damage bubble: linear increase based on max MP above 150; cost scales hard early.
This is the only bubble you can hourly click.
Ranked best of base damage bubbles; placed right above Call Me Pope.
Brain tools gives more skilling power for hatchets and worship skulls; costs cereal flies.
Cereal flies have few other uses; high worship is hard so useful; not super expensive.
Roadkill Cranium Cooking boosts the shaman talent: lasts longer; more progress per kill; lower cooldown; also alchemy XP; costs toilet logs.
S tier; skips years of alchemy progress; strong mid to early game and in endgame; top of S.
Increases brew speed by percentage; multiplicative; also gets doubled; costs Tyson steaks.
Brew speed only applies to colored cauldrons; not distilled water or other waters.
Placed just below XP bubble; barely knew it existed for a long time.
